oral_examination.oral_examination: 1. Facial shape is slightly asymmetrical from left to right; upper and lower labial protrusions on the sides; normal mobility of the bilateral temporomandibular joints, an opening of three fingers, the opening is toward the middle and lower, and no tenderness or snapping in the joint area; 2. Permanent dentition in the mouth, The maxillary and mandibular dental arch tips are rounded, and the anterior segments of the upper and lower dentitions are crowded; 3. The distal relationship of the bilateral molars, the anterior teeth are deeply covered, the overbite is deep, and the midlines of the upper and lower dentitions are uneven; the upper anterior teeth are labially inclined; 4. Oral hygiene is average, with no obvious redness, swelling, abnormality or soft scale in the gums;

treatment_plan.notes: Do not bite hard objects. If you feel any discomfort, follow up with a doctor.

source_handle: Write medical records, keep a complete set of orthodontic information (intraoral photos, facial photos, 3D models, curved tomographic films, lateral cephalograms), and perform orthodontic diagnostic analysis.
